expectations.text: Ranks ports by the share of paying customers on each CI, not by platform popularity, rejecting the 'CircleCI and Jenkins are huge' argument.
expectations.evidence: 'Rank by your paying customers' CI share, not by market popularity'.

expectations.text: Prescribes the default: documented, tested CLI snippets for every CI plus a native package only for the one or two CI systems holding most non-GitHub customers (GitLab, possibly Azure DevOps).
expectations.evidence: Two native ports (GitLab, Azure DevOps), tested snippets for the rest.

expectations.text: Budgets Jenkins last or not at all, stating a Jenkins plugin is a Maven-versioned update-center release justified only by real enterprise revenue on Jenkins.
expectations.evidence: 'The Jenkins plugin (Maven release, minimum core version) is the last candidate'; promote only if the ARR split justifies it.

expectations.text: Rejects per-integration independent logic: every port stays a thin wrapper over the same `mfd` CLI with the same input names, because a port that reimplements logic drifts within a few releases.
expectations.evidence: 'The mfd CLI is the product, and every port is thin packaging over it.'

expectations.text: Keeps one input schema and generates or checks each manifest (`action.yml`, component `spec:inputs`, orb parameters, `pipe.yml` variables, `task.json` inputs) against it.
expectations.evidence: 'Keep one input schema... check each manifest against it: action.yml, component spec:inputs, task.json, snippet variables.'

expectations.text: Fixes the GitLab component: omit `inputs:` under `spec:` while there are none because an empty `inputs:` key fails release creation, and lays out the project with `README.md` plus a top-level `templates/` directory.
expectations.evidence: Fixes the empty inputs: key but never mentions the README.md plus top-level templates/ layout.

expectations.text: Notes GitLab catalog publishing needs a semantic-version release, that `~latest` skips pre-releases but can include breaking changes, and that turning off the catalog toggle destroys catalog metadata.
expectations.evidence: Mentions '~latest can include breaking changes' and semantic-version release, but omits pre-release skipping and the toggle-off metadata loss.

expectations.text: Rejects `dev:latest` for customers: `dev:<label>` orb versions are mutable and expire after 90 days, while production versions `<namespace>/<orb>@1.2.3` are immutable and cannot be deleted, so a bad release is fixed only by a newer one.
expectations.evidence: 'dev: versions are mutable and expire after 90 days... Production orb versions are immutable'.

expectations.text: Chooses the CircleCI namespace once because renaming needs CircleCI support, and documents that partner orbs need customers to allow uncertified orbs in their organization settings.
expectations.evidence: 'Choose the namespace once... Document the "allow uncertified orbs" setting.'

expectations.text: Corrects the Azure DevOps handler: no `Node20` key exists; declare both `Node20_1` and `Node24` during the transition, `Node24` needs `minimumAgentVersion` 4.265.1, and test on the oldest supported Windows Server agent.
expectations.evidence: Node20_1 and Node24; minimumAgentVersion 4.265.1; oldest Windows Server.

expectations.text: Rejects re-pushing the Bitbucket `1.0.0` tag: image tags are mutable on the registry, so publish each version once and never re-push a tag.
expectations.evidence: 'Publish each version once and never re-push a tag.'

expectations.text: Gives each port its own semver bumped by its own contract and publishes one compatibility table mapping each port version to the CLI version range it installs.
expectations.evidence: 'each port gets its own semver'; 'one compatibility table'.

expectations.text: Makes every snippet download a pinned CLI version with checksum verification, set full Git history where the CLI needs it (`fetch-depth: 0` on GitHub, `GIT_DEPTH: 0` on GitLab), and use a glibc base image because `mfd` is not built for musl.
expectations.evidence: 'GIT_DEPTH: 0'; glibc image; pinned CLI verified against committed digest.
